query: Albany Western Australia taxi Uber fare per km base fare 2026
snippet: For general Australian regulated rank-or-hail taxis in 2026, flagfall is about A$2.90 to A$6.15 on the standard day rate, then roughly A$1.90 to A$2.69 per kilometre. No Albany-specific base fare or per-km rate was found; Uber/Western Australia taxi regulator rates for Albany itself are not published in these results.
